title: erodium hoefftianum subsp. neilreichii
intro: Erodium hoefftianum subsp. neilreichii, commonly known as the mountain filaret, is a subspecies of the Erodium hoefftianum plant, belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Erodium hoefftianum subsp. neilreichii include analgesic, antiseptic, and hemostatic effects, which can help alleviate pain, prevent infection, and promote blood clotting. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
